name: Polly the Parrot
steps: Tap the cookie on the floor to collect it.
Tap the cheese to reveal a hidden cookie.
Tap the broom to find a cookie under it.
Tap the mouse hole to get a cookie from the mouse.
Tap the fairy picture to drop a cookie.
Tap the cuckoo clock to take out a cookie.
Tap the microwave to open and get a cookie.
Tap the pet bowl to reveal a hidden cookie.
Tap the kitchen cabinet under sink to open it.
Tap the open shelf to collect the final cookie.
